issue.title: Historical bob_cli_7b_mac_compile plan has a noncanonical PLAN provenance link
issue.description: On 2026-11-01, sase plan links validate --quiet reports 58 errors: 57 known legacy prompts (corroborated on bob-cli-y) plus one distinct link-kind error in plan:202610/bob_cli_7b_mac_compile.md. Audited artifact read confirms its leading PLAN bullet points to plan:202610/capture_link_drops_blocking_deps.md and duplicates the PARENT link, while validation expects a canonical PROMPT provenance link. Resolve the actual originating prompt and repair this one artifact through the supported plan-link workflow, preserving its parent and durable references. Do not merely rename PLAN to PROMPT while keeping a plan target, weaken validation, or sweep unrelated plan bodies. Search across task types and the last-week task sweep found no semantic duplicate; bob-cli-1v concerns wrong commit trailers and bob-cli-dg concerns absent nested sidecars. None of the 12 active epic scopes causally owns this historical artifact. Small: one known artifact header and its provenance resolution, no product changes.

task_type_fields.impact: The global SDD plan-link validator stays red even though the current drawer epic plan links are valid.
task_type_fields.repro: Run sase plan links validate --quiet; observe artifact uses PLAN link; expected PROMPT (link-kind) for 202610/bob_cli_7b_mac_compile.md.

issue.creation_reason: Found by bob-cli-ey.7.land while checking parent linked-plan readiness. This independent historical artifact error keeps repository-wide plan-link validation red and is unrelated to capture drawers.
